working_definition: C3 is a GABAergic centrifugal columnar neuron of the adult Drosophila optic lobe, unicolumnar (one per optic column), that carries signals from the medulla back to the lamina. It arborizes in medulla layers M1-2, M5, and M9-10, forms both presynapses and postsynapses in the lamina, and is strongly presynaptic to L2 and T1 in medulla layer M2 while being strongly postsynaptic to L1.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Adult centrifugal neuron with arborizations in medulla layers M1-2, M5, and M9-10 and more restricted arborizations in the lamina (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Kind et al., 2021). It forms presynapses and postsynapses in the lamina (Morante and Desplan, 2008; Rivera-Alba et al., 2011). In the medulla it is strongly presynaptic to monopolar lamina neuron L2 and columnar neuron T1, and strongly postsynaptic to L1 (Takemura et al., 2013). It is GABAergic (Fei et al., 2010). There is usually one of these cells per optic column (Nern et al., 2025).
